Introduction

Yu Yeonjung is a South Korean singer under Starship Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group WJSN, also known as Cosmic Girls.

Yeonjung was first known when she participated on the first season of Mnet's hit survival show 'Produce 101', which filmed from January to April in 2016. She ranked 11th overall, qualifying to be a member of the final group I.O.I. She debuted as one of the Main Vocalist of the group on May 4, 2016 with the release of the mini album 'Chrysalis'. I.O.I released their last song, "DOWNPOUR", on January 18, 2017, and held a concert from January 20 to 22, before eventually disbanding on January 29, 2017.

On July 11, 2017, it was announced that Yeonjung would be joining WJSN as their thirteenth member. She debuted as a member of the group on August 17, 2016 with their second mini-album 'THE SECRET'.

In September 2019, she was a contestant on the vocal reality survival show 'V-1'. She won the final round and became the winner of the show on September 15th, 2019.
